item.description: ### Fixed - **Amp: Perch's plugin now actually reports to Perch.** Its messages were being dropped, so Amp sessions only appeared from Perch reading Amp's thread history — and a session waiting for your approval never showed as needing you. The same fix applies to OpenCode 1.x. - **Claude Code: Stats read faster with Claude Code 2.1.300,** which writes large new records into its transcripts that Perch now skips.
